notes.title: Patch 0.0.2 - Challenge your friends
notes.notes:
[b] Updates [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some UI bugs
[*] Setting have been added to the menu
[*] You can now play vs your friends (automatically picks the first deck for each player , working on it)
[*] Reduced the game size by 600mb
[*] Reduce the turn time from 2 min to 75 seconds
[*] Added a 45 sec timer to the hand selection menu
[/list]


[b] Know urgent bugs [/b]

[list]
[*]  Issue when a player leaves an lobby and simultasneoly another player is looking for a lobby
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer is now live
notes.notes:
Multiplayer is now live for testing

Feedback, bug reports are appreciated and will help with the development of Olympian Wars
As soon as Multiplayer is working with no problems I will add the feature to play vs your friends

The current leaderboard is live for testing purposes, most likely to be reseted at some point in the future

Changed card art for same cards and now when previewing a card in the "Collection" menu you mouse scroll use the arrow keys or A and D to go to the next card

Thanks to everybody that has played the demo and wishlisted Olympian Wars 

See you in the arena
